title: A Mirror-Descent Algorithm for Computing the Petz-Rényi Capacity of Classical-Quantum Channels
summary: We study the computation of the $α$-Rényi capacity of a classical-quantum (c-q) channel for $α\in(0,1)$. We propose an exponentiated-gradient (mirror descent) iteration that generalizes the Blahut-Arimoto algorithm. Our analysis establishes relative smoothness with respect to the entropy geometry, guaranteeing a global sublinear convergence of the objective values.
